decisions.reason: The DPA management tool draws on the firm's GDPR-compliant hosting expertise for agencies, and the positive customer feedback on its roughly 200 agency templates is a signal the firm can interpret and build on, though it sits somewhat further from the core hosting knowledge.
The hosting management platform is featured on the home page and lies at the heart of the firm's existing technical knowledge base, so it is central to the business and easy to keep improving.
The configurable managed hosting plan extends the firm's core managed hosting competence, and its continued dedicated page suggests it remains a stable part of the offering.

Extended PHP security support builds directly on the firm's server and PHP know-how and serves agency clients with legacy sites, although its only-a-mention web presence and dependence on PHP version lifecycles make it somewhat more likely to be scaled back.
